opener_concept: A car at a steady 20 m/s for 3 s: distance = 20x3 = 60 m is the area under a flat speed-time line (introduces area / trapezium rule); the same line on a distance-time graph climbs 60/3 = 20 m each second, which is its gradient (= speed). One journey names both big ideas: gradient = rate, area = total.
